[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Things to do in Tampa Bay this weekend | Aug. 7-9
item.description: If you're looking for something fun to do this weekend (Aug. 7-9), there's plenty of action happening around the Tampa Bay area.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Cubans struggle to bounce back after 6th nationwide blackout this year
item.description: Cubans on Monday were recovering from the sixth islandwide blackout this year, as the nation remains in free-fall after the Trump administration effectively cut it off from oil in January.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ariana Grande withdraws from London musical, will take a break from the public
item.description: Ariana Grande has pulled out of an upcoming stage musical in London, producers said, and plans to withdraw from the public eye for a break from the intense scrutiny she faces.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough Education Foundation helping more teachers get school supplies as demand grows with rising costs
item.description: More teachers are utilizing the resources provided by Hillsborough Education Foundation, to get free school supplies, as costs rise and supplies become unaffordable for many.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Michigan reports first deaths linked to multistate cyclosporiasis outbreak

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lakeland officials pass 1-year data center moratorium
item.description: The City Commission of the City of Lakeland voted 4-3 to pass a one-year moratorium on the development of large-scale data centers on Monday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas County Superintendent talks about school consolidation, cellphones policies
item.description: In Pinellas County students return to the classroom on August 11. Tampa Bay 28 anchor Paul LaGrone sat down with the Pinellas County Superintendent Kevin Hendrick to discuss a wide variety of topics.
